query: Читай сообщения из Kafka-топика events.all. Если поле type равно purchase — пиши в PostgreSQL таблицу purchases. Если type равно refund — пиши в таблицу refunds. Всё остальное — в Kafka-топик events.unknown.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: event_router_pipeline
  name: Event Router Pipeline
  description: Read events from Kafka, route to PostgreSQL or Kafka based on type
    field
triggers:
- id: trigger_stream
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 minute
sources:
- id: source_kafka
  name: Kafka Source
  type: Kafka
  location: events.all
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
      group_id: event_router_group
processing_elements:
- id: process_router
  name: Type Router
  operation: Router
  config:
    field: type
    routes:
      purchase: sink_pg_purchases
      refund: sink_pg_refunds
      default: sink_kafka_unknown
sinks:
- id: sink_pg_purchases
  name: PostgreSQL Purchases
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.purchases
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
- id: sink_pg_refunds
  name: PostgreSQL Refunds
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.refunds
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
- id: sink_kafka_unknown
  name: Kafka Unknown Sink
  type: Kafka
  location: events.unknown
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
processed_data:
- id: events_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_kafka
  to_id: process_router
  data_ref: events_json
- from_id: process_router
  to_id: sink_pg_purchases
  data_ref: events_json
- from_id: process_router
  to_id: sink_pg_refunds
  data_ref: events_json
- from_id: process_router
  to_id: sink_kafka_unknown
  data_ref: events_json
